## IPublishSarifReviewInput.statePath property

Absolute path of the durable publication state file: the identity of this publication. Retry with the same path; never delete it after an`uncertain` outcome. A new path starts a new, separate review.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly statePath: string;
```
